title: U.S. Treasury Yield Spreads
revision_note: Computed from FRED's H.15 constant-maturity series, which are not revised after publication.

inputs.label: 10-year, 2-year and 3-month Treasury constant-maturity yields (DGS10, DGS2, DGS3MO)

methodology: 10y-2y = DGS10 − DGS2; 10y-3m = DGS10 − DGS3MO. Computed per date in Python from the daily constant-maturity series, only where both legs report — no forward-fill or interpolation — so each spread spans its own valid date range.
Computed at fetch time from FRED's constant-maturity legs rather than pulled from FRED's own precomputed T10Y2Y / T10Y3M series.
notes: A negative value indicates an inverted curve segment.

presentation.summary: Daily 10-year minus 2-year and 10-year minus 3-month Treasury yield spreads, from FRED, with NBER recessions shaded.
